descripcion_geo: Aramaic kingdom north of Damascus, between Lebanon and the Euphrates; power that David defeated in the expansion of his kingdom.
importancia_estrategica: enemy Aramaic kingdom of David; His defeat extended Israelite dominion to the Euphrates.

historias.titulo: David defeats Hadadezer king of Zobah
historias.descripcion: David defeats King Hadadezer of Zoba, capturing 1,700 cavalry and 20,000 soldiers; the Arameans of Damascus come to the aid and are also defeated.

historias.titulo: Zobah's army in the Ammonite war
historias.descripcion: The Ammonites hire the army of Zobah to confront David; Joab defeats them on two fronts.

historias.titulo: The copper of the Temple from Sobá
historias.descripcion: David took large quantities of bronze from the cities of Zoba; Solomon used that metal for the Temple utensils.

personajes.descripcion: He was defeated twice by David; His metallic treasures ended up in the Temple of Jerusalem.
He defeated Zobah, extending Israelite dominion to the Euphrates, fulfilling his promise to Abraham.
He commanded the battle against Zobah's army on the Ammonite front.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Sobá: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: The metal of Sobá in the Temple

judaismo.descripcion: The bronze of Zobah captured by David was melted to make the utensils of the Temple: the treasures of the defeated enemy serve the glory of God.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The bronze of Zobah captured by David was melted to make the utensils of the Temple: the treasures of the defeated enemy serve the glory of God.
